sloka: अवज्ञया कृतम् हन्यात् दातारम् न अत्र संशयः ।ततः कैश्चित् अहो रात्रैः उपयाता महीक्षितः ॥१-१३-३४॥
transliteration: avajñayā kṛtam hanyāt dātāram na atra saṁśayaḥ ।tataḥ kaiścit aho rātraiḥ upayātā mahīkṣitaḥ ॥1-13-34॥

translations.english: "O king, persons with composed minds have made preparations for the yaga. Now be pleased to leave for sacrificial altar nearby to perform yaga.
